messages.content: Reserve a parking spot in the city center for tomorrow afternoon

message.content:
I can’t actually make the reservation from here, but I can help you **book the right spot**.

For **tomorrow afternoon in the city center**, the best-match options in downtown San Jose appear to be garages that are **open 24 hours**, including **Market & San Pedro Square Garage**, **Convention Center Garage**, **Third Street Garage**, **4th & San Fernando Garage**, and **2nd & San Carlos Garage**.[1] ParkSJ also notes **90 minutes free at 5 city garages**, which may be useful if your stay is short.[1]

To reserve, use the parking reservation flow on a parking marketplace such as Parking.com, which lets you **search parking spaces**, **compare options**, and **reserve your parking pass**.[8]

If you want, I can help you narrow it down by:
- **Exact city center area**
- **Arrival time tomorrow afternoon**
- **How long you need parking**
- **Whether you want the cheapest option or the closest one**
